programs.name: west_bent_court_bar
programs.rationale: Bent bar with central court and lifted west threshold; a connected calm ground-active mixed-use mass.

programs.name: west_split_wing_bridge
programs.rationale: Split wing with a physical bridge and west notch; reads as two connected wings with active ground seam.

programs.name: west_terraced_setback_block
programs.rationale: Stepped block with terrace hierarchy and a west-open court; compact civic mixed-use section.

programs.name: west_corner_wedge_cluster
programs.rationale: Corner-cut wedge cluster with punched street edge; a low oblique commercial mass distinct from bar families.

programs.name: west_lifted_pavilion
programs.rationale: Lifted pavilion-like slab with a west-open void; emphasizes active ground clearance and light upper calm.

programs.name: west_cross_mass_court
programs.rationale: Cross-shaped mass with west court and entry notch; a civic knot rather than a bar.

programs.name: west_barrel_bent_prism
programs.rationale: Continuous curved section in a profiled prism with a west-open court; varied through section rather than footprint.

programs.name: west_stacked_terrace_bar
programs.rationale: Stacked calm bar with stepped terrace and west notch; a layered mixed-use section with active ground edge.
